personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: An intelligent, Apple-inspired gamified mentor that blends premium glass aesthetics with friendly, engaging progression mechanics.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-inspired vertical rhythm. Content should breathe. Cards must not touch screen edges. Use consistent 16pt (lg) or 24pt (xl) padding for screen roots.

do's: Use semi-transparent (8-15% opacity) frosted-glass panels over dark or gradient backgrounds
Apply 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15) subtle borders to define glass cards
Limit glass layers to 1-2 per screen (e.g., bottom tab bar and hero card)
Ensure text on glass uses high contrast (onSurfaceInverse or solid white) and passes WCAG AA
dont's: Do not apply glass to everything; reading areas and standard list rows should be solid for accessibility
Do not stack more than two blur layers to prevent GPU strain
Do not use glass for text inputs

screens.name: Conversational AI Onboarding
screens.purpose: A contextual, adaptive chat that collects user goals through slot-filling without feeling like a form.

states.loading: Typing indicator (three bouncing dots) in a chat bubble
states.empty: AI greeting message with 3 suggested goal chips
states.error: Inline fallback message 'Let's try that again.'

screens.layout: Bottom-heavy chat interface. Top header minimal (just a 'Skip' button). AI messages align left, user messages right. Heavy use of Quick Reply chips (tap-ready options) below the AI bubble to minimize typing. Dark/Light mode contrasting chat bubbles. The text input rests just above the keyboard with a glassmorphism pill shape.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: The student's command center combining daily missions, streak mechanics, and AI motivation.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching the layout of hero card and mission list
states.empty: Glass hero card with an illustration, prompting 'Start your first mission.'
states.error: Card displaying 'Could not load today's plan' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Header contains User avatar and current Level/Streak badge. Below header: a premium Glassmorphism Hero Card overlaid on an abstract gradient background displaying the AI's motivational message and current focus score. Underneath: 2-column grid of 'Missions' or a vertical list with Duolingo-style rounded cards. Tab bar at the bottom uses a frosted glass effect.

screens.name: AI Coach Chat
screens.purpose: A continuous mentoring dialogue space with streaming responses and inline action cards.

states.loading: Centered spinner for history, pulsing text for streaming responses.

screens.layout: Standard full-screen chat but heavily stylized. AI messages can render rich components (Markdown, mini-charts, or roadmap nodes) inline, not just text. Input area is sticky at the bottom with an animated gradient 'Send/Record' button.

screens.name: Adaptive Roadmap
screens.purpose: Visualizes long-term and daily plans as a continuous, gamified journey.

states.empty: Illustration of a map with 'Let's plot your success path' CTA.
states.error: Error state overlay with retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scrolling timeline. Nodes alternate left/right, similar to an Apple Maps route or Duolingo path. Completed nodes have filled gradient circles; upcoming nodes are outlined. Section headers for Months/Weeks use a subtle glassmorphism sticky header as the user scrolls.

screens.name: Reports & Gamification
screens.purpose: Showcases XP, badges, and productivity metrics via beautiful charts.

states.loading: Skeleton of charts and badge grids.
states.empty: Empty placeholder 'Complete missions to earn badges!'
states.error: Error card with a retry fetch action.

screens.layout: Top section features a large Circular Progress ring (Apple Fitness style) for XP. Below: A 2-column grid displaying unlocked achievements/badges inside brandTertiary tinted containers. Bottom section: Beautiful smooth line charts (using Reanimated) showing productivity and focus scores over the week.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Abstract blue and purple gradient background for hero card

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette! The user specifically requested Blue and Purple. Utilize `brandPrimary` (Purple) and `brandSecondary` (Blue) for gradients.

Implement Glassmorphism 2.0 (12-20px blur, 8-15% transparency, 1px subtle white borders). Use `expo-blur` heavily on the Tab Bar, sticky headers, and the main Dashboard Hero Card, but keep readable areas solid.
For the Hero Card, place the abstract gradient image as a background (`expo-image` at base layer) and overlay the glass panel. Ensure text legibility via a dark scrim or solid typography.
The Onboarding should use a Conversational AI pattern. Implement 'Quick Reply' chips (horizontal ScrollView of tap-ready options) below the AI's chat bubble to reduce typing.
For Gamification (Dashboard and Reports), implement rounded Duolingo-style cards (`lg` or `pill` radius) with subtle shadows (shadow_tier 1) and bold, thick progress rings.
Use `Plus Jakarta Sans` for titles and bold numbers (XP, Level), and `Geist` for body text and chat bubbles.
Always wrap scrollable content with sticky actions safely above the home indicator. Provide bottom padding equivalent to the sticky CTA height + margin.
